settings.label: Logo image
settings.info: Leave empty to show the shop name as a serif wordmark.

settings.label: Show the bundled demo images where no image is set
settings.info: Placeholder photography shipped with the theme. Switch off once you have uploaded your own images.

settings.label: Maximum page width
settings.info: The design was drawn at 1280 px.

settings.content: Pre-launch mode. The primary call to action everywhere becomes the waitlist form; the real checkout stays wired up but hidden behind a small secondary link you can switch on the day you start taking money.

settings.label: Vorbestell-Modus aktiv
settings.info: On: waitlist is the primary action, prices are labelled as expected prices, the pre-order badge replaces the star rating. Off: the theme behaves like a normal shop.

settings.label: Kaufen-Link zusätzlich anzeigen
settings.info: Shows the small “Jetzt vorbestellen →” link next to the waitlist button, which really adds to the cart. Only switch this on once Impressum, AGB, Widerrufsbelehrung, Versandkosten and the binding delivery date are live — a paid pre-order is a distance-selling contract under German law.

settings.label: Voraussichtlicher Liefertermin
settings.info: Replace the placeholder with a real date before you run ads. If you take money (checkout link on) this has to be a binding date, not an estimate.

settings.label: Anker der Vormerk-Sektion
settings.info: Every pre-order button scrolls here. Must match the anchor set on the “Waitlist” section.

settings.label: Seite „Mehr erzählen“
settings.info: Optional. Linked from the waitlist confirmation — point it at the page using the “Interest form” template.

settings.content: Everything the price lines, the offer cards and the return section read from. Keep the numbers in sync with Settings → Versand and with the Widerruf / AGB page.

settings.label: Versandkostenfrei für jede Bestellung
settings.info: An: alle Zeilen sagen „Versandkostenfrei“ und „Endpreis“ statt „ab X €“. Nur einschalten, wenn der kostenlose Versand in Einstellungen → Versand wirklich für die kleinstmögliche Bestellung gilt.

settings.label: Versandkostenfrei ab (€)
settings.info: 0 = off. Shown in the announcement bar, on the set cards and in the return section. Must match the free-shipping rate in Settings → Versand.

settings.label: Streichpreise anzeigen
settings.info: Off: no struck-through prices and no −X % badges anywhere. Only switch on if the compare-at price was really charged in the last 30 days — § 11 PAngV.

settings.label: Grundpreis anzeigen
settings.info: Required in Germany for cosmetics sold by volume: the price per 100 ml next to every price.

settings.label: Füllmenge pro Flasche (ml)
settings.info: Used to calculate the Grundpreis per 100 ml and to read old volume-only variant titles (300 ml = 3 bottles).

settings.label: Seite „Versand & Zahlung“
settings.info: Linked from the “inkl. MwSt., zzgl. Versand” line (§ 6 PAngV) and from the return section.

settings.label: Seite „Widerruf & Rückgabe“
settings.info: Linked from the 30-day return item in the return section.

settings.label: Seite „Datenschutz“
settings.info: Linked from the consent checkbox on every form.

settings.label: Use the design fonts (Cormorant Garamond + Jost)
settings.info: Loads both fonts from Google Fonts, exactly as in the design. Uncheck to use Shopify-hosted fonts instead.

settings.label: Headline font (Shopify-hosted)
settings.info: Only used when the design fonts above are switched off.

settings.label: Body font (Shopify-hosted)
settings.info: Only used when the design fonts above are switched off.

settings.label: Open the cart drawer after adding to cart
Note under the checkout button
